dialogues.en: "Everyone seems to be working hard."
dialogues.text: "Everyone seems to be working hard."

dialogues.jp: 用を足し、トイレを後にする。
dialogues.en:
I'm here to help the club. My work is easy because I don't
have too many things to do, but I also feel bored at the
same time.
dialogues.text:
I'm here to help the club. My work is easy because I don't
have too many things to do, but I also feel bored at the
same time.

dialogues.jp: 音楽室では、相変わらず練習が続いている。
dialogues.en: "Hi, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hi, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: 「みんな頑張ってるなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Uh, hello."
dialogues.text: "Uh, hello."

dialogues.jp:
手伝いで来ているが、用事そのものは多くない
ので、楽でいいけど暇でもある。
dialogues.en: "It's been a long time."
dialogues.text: "It's been a long time."

dialogues.jp: こんなところで萌先輩に会おうとは……。
dialogues.en: I didn't expect to see Moe-sempai here...
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to see Moe-sempai here...

dialogues.jp: （って、先輩も音楽部じゃん）
dialogues.en: (Come on, she also belongs to the music club.)
dialogues.text: (Come on, she also belongs to the music club.)

dialogues.jp: でも、１度も会わなかったな。なんでだ？
dialogues.en:
But how come I never see her here even though she belongs to
the music club?
dialogues.text:
But how come I never see her here even though she belongs to
the music club?

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩は演奏とかしないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you play music?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you play music?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。私は占いのほうを手伝っているんです」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't. I help with the fortune-telling part."
dialogues.text: "No, I don't. I help with the fortune-telling part."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「占い？」
dialogues.en: "Fortune-telling?"
dialogues.text: "Fortune-telling?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。演奏の他に音楽部で占いをするんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. As well as playing music, we also do fortune-telling."
dialogues.text: "Yes. As well as playing music, we also do fortune-telling."

dialogues.jp:
ひとつの部でふたつの出し物か。結構、部員数
が多いんだな。
dialogues.en:
One club does two different things. There are a few too many
people in this club.
dialogues.text:
One club does two different things. There are a few too many
people in this club.

dialogues.jp: （でも、なぜ占い？）
dialogues.en: (But why fortune-telling?)
dialogues.text: (But why fortune-telling?)

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そこの第２音楽室で準備をしているんですよ」
dialogues.en: "We're preparing in the second music room over there."
dialogues.text: "We're preparing in the second music room over there."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったんですか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, OK."
dialogues.text: "Oh, OK."

dialogues.jp:
もっと前に知っていたら……暇つぶしに遊びに
行ったのに。
dialogues.en:
If I had known that sooner, I could have visited the room to
pass away the idle hours.
dialogues.text:
If I had known that sooner, I could have visited the room to
pass away the idle hours.

dialogues.jp: （でも、手伝わされそうだな）
dialogues.en: (But I might get forced to help them.)
dialogues.text: (But I might get forced to help them.)

dialogues.jp:
余計な仕事を手伝わされるぐらいなら、まだ、
眞子たちの演奏を聴いているほうが楽かも。
dialogues.en:
Even though I'm tired of listening to the music that Mako's
group plays, I'd rather listen to it than be involved in
additional work.
dialogues.text:
Even though I'm tired of listening to the music that Mako's
group plays, I'd rather listen to it than be involved in
additional work.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……ちょっと｛き／訊｝いてもよろしいでしょう
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Um... Do you mind if I ask you a question?"
dialogues.text: "Um... Do you mind if I ask you a question?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「何ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Go ahead."
dialogues.text: "Go ahead."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、眞子ちゃんとデートをしたと聞いたん
　ですが……本当でしょうか？」
dialogues.en:
"I heard that you had a date with Mako-chan yesterday... Is
it true?"
dialogues.text:
"I heard that you had a date with Mako-chan yesterday... Is
it true?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp:
眞子から聞いたのか……まぁ姉妹だし、別に隠
す必要もないか。
dialogues.en:
Did she hear this from Mako?... Well, there's no reason to
hide it, because they're sisters anyway.
dialogues.text:
Did she hear this from Mako?... Well, there's no reason to
hide it, because they're sisters anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「ええ、一応」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it's true."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it's true."

dialogues.jp: さすがに、ちょっと顔が熱くなる。
dialogues.en: My face is becoming a little hot.
dialogues.text: My face is becoming a little hot.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……つき合って、いるんですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Um... Are you guys dating?"
dialogues.text: "Um... Are you guys dating?"

dialogues.jp: それは……。
dialogues.en: It's...
dialogues.text: It's...

dialogues.jp: ふと、周りを見る。
dialogues.en: I suddenly scan the place.
dialogues.text: I suddenly scan the place.

dialogues.jp: 廊下には、何人か学生の姿があった。
dialogues.en: There are some students in the hallway.
dialogues.text: There are some students in the hallway.

dialogues.jp:
ここで否定したら、せっかくの恋人のフリが、
無意味になる。
dialogues.en:
If I deny this now, all the time we spent acting as a couple
will be meaningless.
dialogues.text:
If I deny this now, all the time we spent acting as a couple
will be meaningless.

dialogues.jp: 俺は首を縦に振りながら答える。
dialogues.en: I reply, nodding my head.
dialogues.text: I reply, nodding my head.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Uh, yes?"
dialogues.text: "Uh, yes?"

dialogues.jp: 唐突に、萌先輩の顔にいつもの微笑みが戻る。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Moe-sempai's usual smile comes back to her face.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Moe-sempai's usual smile comes back to her face.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子ちゃんのこと、よろしくお願いしますね」
dialogues.en: "Please take care of Mako-chan."
dialogues.text: "Please take care of Mako-chan."

dialogues.jp:
頭にいろんなことが浮かび上がるが、俺にはそ
れしか言えなかった。
dialogues.en:
Many things went through my head, but that was the only
thing I could say.
dialogues.text:
Many things went through my head, but that was the only
thing I could say.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあ、失礼しますね。朝倉くんも、お
　手伝いのほう、頑張ってください」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I have to go now. Asakura-kun, keep up the good work
for the music club."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I have to go now. Asakura-kun, keep up the good work
for the music club."

dialogues.jp:
最後はニッコリ微笑んで、萌先輩は第２音楽室
に消えていった。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai gives me a beaming smile and disappears into the
second music room.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai gives me a beaming smile and disappears into the
second music room.

dialogues.jp: 俺も戻るか……。
dialogues.en: I guess I should go back, too...
dialogues.text: I guess I should go back, too...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉。どこいってたのよ？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura. Where have you been?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura. Where have you been?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと男子トイレにな」
dialogues.en: "The boys' toilet."
dialogues.text: "The boys' toilet."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「わざわざ“男子”をつける必要があんたには
　あるの？」
dialogues.en: "Is there any reason that you had to mention 'boys'?"
dialogues.text: "Is there any reason that you had to mention 'boys'?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「俺にはないな」
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.jp: 必要のあるやつ（悪友）なら知っているが。
dialogues.en: I know someone who needs to mention that, though.
dialogues.text: I know someone who needs to mention that, though.

dialogues.jp:
「それはそうと、おまえ、萌先輩に昨日俺たち
　がデートしたこと、話したのか？」
dialogues.en: "So anyway, did you tell Moe-sempai that we had a date?"
dialogues.text: "So anyway, did you tell Moe-sempai that we had a date?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え、なんで！？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you asking me about it!?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you asking me about it!?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「たった今廊下で萌先輩に会って、つき合って
　るのか訊かれたからさ」
dialogues.en: "I just saw her in the hallway, and she asked me about it."
dialogues.text: "I just saw her in the hallway, and she asked me about it."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それで……なんて答えたの？」
dialogues.en: "So... What did you tell her?"
dialogues.text: "So... What did you tell her?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　『付き合ってる』としか答えてないぞ。
　周りに人がいたからな」
dialogues.en:
"Mm? I admitted that we're dating, because there were some
other people there too."
dialogues.text:
"Mm? I admitted that we're dating, because there were some
other people there too."

dialogues.jp:
眞子の顔色を窺いながら答える。何かマズかっ
たか……？
dialogues.en:
I answer, watching her expression. Did I say something
wrong......?
dialogues.text:
I answer, watching her expression. Did I say something
wrong......?

dialogues.jp:
「だから、萌先輩にはあとで眞子からフォロー
　入れといてくれよ」
dialogues.en: "So you're gonna have to explain this to Moe-sempai later."
dialogues.text: "So you're gonna have to explain this to Moe-sempai later."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……分かった」

それ以上、眞子はなにも言わなかったので、と
りあえずこの話はよしとする。
dialogues.en:
That seems to be the end of this topic, because Mako doesn't
say another word.
dialogues.text:
That seems to be the end of this topic, because Mako doesn't
say another word.

dialogues.jp: 「ところで……手伝うことない？」
dialogues.en: "By the way... Is there anything I can help you guys with?"
dialogues.text: "By the way... Is there anything I can help you guys with?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「は？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What? What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
やる気まんまんな俺を、眞子が知らない人間で
も見るような目で見つめる。
dialogues.en:
Mako looks at me like I'm a crazy person, even though I'm
ready and willing to work.
dialogues.text:
Mako looks at me like I'm a crazy person, even though I'm
ready and willing to work.

dialogues.jp: 「さあな。今だけ、手伝いたい気分なんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know. But I feel like helping you guys just for
now."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know. But I feel like helping you guys just for
now."

dialogues.jp:
袖を捲り上げる俺の耳に“病院”と呟く眞子の
声が聞こえてきた……。
dialogues.en:
As I tuck my sleeves up, I hear Mako murmuring
'Hospital'......
dialogues.text:
As I tuck my sleeves up, I hear Mako murmuring
'Hospital'......

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩が気にしている◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
廊下で偶然萌先輩に会い、眞子と付き合ってい
るのか尋ねられた。
dialogues.en: I relieve myself and leave the restroom.
dialogues.text: I relieve myself and leave the restroom.

dialogues.jp:
周りに人の目もあったので取りあえず、付き合っ
ていると答えておいたのだった。
dialogues.en: People are still practicing the music in the music room.
dialogues.text: People are still practicing the music in the music room.
